top_pain_points.review_reason: Two separate but related issues converge on the same user outcome: autonomous task features are completely non-functional. Issue #2018 shows the Python backend is entirely absent from the installer (65+ code references to the backend exist but files aren't bundled). Issue #2017 shows the Bash tool layer also fails to discover user toolchains due to non-login shell + incomplete PATH list. Together they represent a complete breakdown of the core autonomous task workflow — planning, spec pipeline, and implementation all fail because the underlying execution environment is broken.

source_issues.title: Missing Python backend (spec_runner.py) in v2.8.0-beta.6 - autonomous tasks not working
source_issues.evidence: Auto-detection fails with 'Auto-build source path not found' error; resources/ dir contains only prompts/ with no backend/; features affected: Tasks, Changelog, Insights, Ideation, Roadmap

source_issues.title: Bash tool can't find user-installed CLI tools (Flutter, Puro, FVM, asdf, etc.) — non-login shell + missing PATH augmentation
source_issues.evidence: Bash tool runs non-login shell, user's rc files (flutter/puro paths) not sourced; autonomous tasks fail at execution phase with 'command not found' for Flutter, Dart, and other toolchains

source_issues.title: [BUG]: Experiment run CSV export missing dataset metadata rows
source_issues.evidence: Self-hosted user on 12.35.0: CSV export from datasets/{id}/experiments omits per-example metadata despite including inputs and outputs. Explicitly states 'This prevents users from analyzing or processing experiment results with associated metadata, and requires manual work (dataset joins, etc.) to retrieve missing data.'

source_issues.title: bug(tauri): gptme-server sidecar persists after gptme-tauri quits
source_issues.evidence: Post-quit `ps` shows gptme-server processes still running. Port 5700 remains occupied. Reuse-on-restart logic masks the problem silently. Repeated cycles accumulate orphaned processes.

source_issues.title: bug(tauri): server port already in use warning on app startup
source_issues.evidence: Fresh app launch shows 'server port already in use' warning because previous server process wasn't terminated. Classic zombie child process issue triggered by crashes or force-quit.

source_issues.title: tauri: gptme-server instance are left running after app close
source_issues.evidence: Third independent report confirming the same zombie process pattern. Suggests intercepting quit event and closing server before app exit.

source_issues.title: bug(cf-pages): Cloudflare Pages preview build fails with pre-existing TypeScript errors
source_issues.evidence: CF Pages build fails on every PR (observed on #2265, #2247, #2241, #2233 and others) because Cloudflare runs `npm run build` via bun with stricter typechecking than GH Actions. Errors exist on master today.

source_issues.title: track(webui): bun has never produced a working build — npm-only is currently enforced via wrangler.toml
source_issues.evidence: Root cause: bun resolves newer package versions causing API drift. bun.lockb was deleted and npm-only enforced via wrangler.toml as workaround. Risk of someone regenerating bun.lockb and silently re-breaking CF Pages.

source_issues.title: bug(tauri): shell command execution stalls (hangs on simple commands like ls)
source_issues.evidence: Observed with simple `ls` command — never returned output, no timeout, no error. Requires conversation restart. Reported on macOS 15.4.1, gptme dev build (tauri).

source_issues.title: Context bloat: include_paths embeds same file multiple times and has no size cap
source_issues.evidence: Real-world observed: autonomous-run.sh prompt grew from ~6 KB to 561,205 chars after include_paths. Two consecutive gptme:grok-4.20 sessions terminated at 0.1 grade with zero assistant output (180-190s wall time, context window exhausted mid-lesson-injection). signals.review_reason: Developer experience blocking: every PR triggers a broken CF Pages preview deployment, creating persistent false-negative CI noise. This forces developers to ignore a CI check or wait for a separate fix. Combined with bun lockfile risk of silent re-breakage (count=2), this is a recurring workflow disruption for all contributors.

source_issues.title: bug(cf-pages): Cloudflare Pages preview build fails with pre-existing TypeScript errors
source_issues.evidence: CF Pages build fails on every PR (observed on #2265, #2247, #2241, #2233 and others) because Cloudflare runs `npm run build` via bun with stricter typechecking than GH Actions. Errors exist on master today.

source_issues.title: track(webui): bun has never produced a working build — npm-only is currently enforced via wrangler.toml

signals.topic: Tauri desktop app shell command execution stalls/hangs indefinitely
signals.summary: Shell commands executed through gptme-tauri (e.g. `ls`) hang indefinitely with no output, no timeout, no error — requiring conversation restart. This is a main-flow blocking failure in the desktop app.
signals.review_reason: Main-flow blocking: shell tool execution is core to gptme's functionality. When commands hang indefinitely with no timeout and no error, the entire workflow is frozen and the session must be restarted. This is a critical desktop app regression affecting the primary use case.

source_issues.title: bug(tauri): shell command execution stalls (hangs on simple commands like ls)
source_issues.evidence: Observed with simple `ls` command — never returned output, no timeout, no error. Requires conversation restart. Reported on macOS 15.4.1, gptme dev build (tauri).

signals.topic: Context window exhaustion from repeated file embedding without deduplication or size cap
signals.summary: include_paths() embeds the same file multiple times (N mentions = N embeddings) with no per-file or per-message size budget. This causes prompts to balloon from ~6 KB to 500 KB+, exhausting context windows and producing zero-output sessions with 0.1 grade on smaller models.
aliases: context window exhausted by repeated file inclusion
zero output sessions due to context overflow
signals.review_reason: Main-flow blocking: autonomous sessions produce zero output due to context window exhaustion. The root cause (no deduplication + no size cap) silently corrupts model behavior on smaller-context models, making the tool unreliable for its core use case. Two confirmed zero-output sessions with concrete evidence of 500KB+ prompt bloat.

source_issues.title: Context bloat: include_paths embeds same file multiple times and has no size cap
source_issues.evidence: Real-world observed: autonomous-run.sh prompt grew from ~6 KB to 561,205 chars after include_paths. Two consecutive gptme:grok-4.20 sessions terminated at 0.1 grade with zero assistant output (180-190s wall time, context window exhausted mid-lesson-injection). Smaller models silently degraded, bandit penalty misattributed to model.

signals.topic: Agent instruction files re-injected on working directory change, wasting tokens
signals.summary: When the working directory changes to a different checkout (e.g. git worktree), injected files like AGENTS.md are re-injected even when content is identical to what's already in context. The _loaded_agent_files_var tracks filenames not content hashes, causing duplicate identical content.
aliases: duplicate AGENTS.md injection on cwd change
injected files reloaded by path not content
token waste from duplicate file injection
signals.review_reason: Token waste from duplicate content injection is a measurable cost loss, especially on large instruction files and in autonomous mode with worktree usage. The bug silently consumes context budget and degrades model focus. While count=1, the cost impact and ease of reproduction (any worktree switch triggers it) justify P1.

source_issues.title: bug: duplicate agent instruction file injection on cwd change
source_issues.evidence: AGENTS.md injected from ~/Programming/gptme/AGENTS.md, then re-injected from /tmp/worktrees/gptme-version-fix/AGENTS.md when cwd changed. Same content loaded twice due to path-based (not content-hash-based) tracking. Pure token waste with no benefit.

signals.review_reason: 主流程阻断（创建新对话时沙箱报错），有明确错误类型（SandboxError 500）和操作系统证据（CentOS 7）。虽然 count=1，但属于平台级阻断性 bug，不限于单一功能失效。

source_issues.title: [Bug]: centos7：openhands.app_server.errors.SandboxError:500:Sandbox entered error state

signals.review_reason: API 层面崩溃（500错误），影响文件处理主流程。当用户处理目录或路径不存在的文件时会触发，属于关键功能不可用场景。

source_issues.title: action_execution_server.is_binary lacks os.path.isfile guard, crashes 500 on directory/missing paths
source_issues.evidence: is_binary() called without os.path.isfile() guard, crashes with 500 error when given directory or non-existent file paths. Causes API-level crash, not just a feature regression.

source_issues.title: [Bug]: Missing required parameters for function 'execute_bash': {'security_risk'}

signals.topic: CoPilot agent-builder hardcodes Google Drive file IDs instead of using AgentGoogleDriveFileInputBlock, causing repeated validation failures across agent versions
signals.summary: CoPilot consistently produces broken agent graphs for Google Drive workflows. It hardcodes file IDs into block constantInput instead of wiring AgentGoogleDriveFileInputBlock, resulting in Pydantic validation rejections or runtime credential failures. A beta user encountered this across 13 saved versions without CoPilot ever self-correcting—even when explicitly given the error message. Additionally, the agent-generator validator rejects AgentInputBlock subclasses, preventing CoPilot from saving agents using the correct input block.
aliases: Drive file credential failure in agent graphs
signals.review_reason: Main workflow blocker for agent-building via CoPilot. A beta user was actively blocked from building functional Google Drive-connected agents across 13 consecutive CoPilot attempts—the system repeated the same failure without self-correction, requiring manual intervention each time. This is not an edge case: it directly breaks the CoPilot-to-agent authoring flow, the core user journey for the platform.

source_issues.title: CoPilot agent-builder should use AgentGoogleDriveFileInputBlock for Drive files, not hardcode IDs
source_issues.evidence: Beta user hit this anti-pattern repeatedly over 13 saved versions of one agent (graph 3477e4ec-08b2-4ca5-bffe-ca2729fbc36e). CoPilot produced the broken shape every time: versions 4-6 got Turkish placeholder strings rejected by Pydantic; versions 7-10 got bare file IDs also rejected; versions 11-13 passed validation but failed at runtime due to missing _credentials_id. Even after the user pasted the explicit Pydantic error directly into chat, CoPilot did not correct the pattern. Also includes a secondary blocker: the agent-generator validator rejects AgentInputBlock subclasses, preventing CoPilot from ever saving an agent that uses AgentGoogleDriveFileInputBlock as its sole input.

signals.topic: AutoPilot hallucinates and requests wrong OAuth credential provider (GitHub instead of Google/Gmail), blocking Gmail block execution
signals.summary: When a user asks AutoPilot to perform Gmail tasks, the system incorrectly emits a setup_requirements tool call requesting GitHub credentials instead of Google credentials. Users must delete all Google integrations and reconnect to recover—a disruptive workaround that indicates a systemic auth confusion issue.
signals.review_reason: Directly blocks the Gmail integration—a key platform feature—by wrong provider credential request. The workaround (delete all Google integrations + reconnect) is non-obvious and disruptive, indicating a real user-facing auth failure rather than an edge case. Classified as P0 despite count=1 because the review_reason provides unambiguous user impact evidence in production.

source_issues.title: AutoPilot hallucinates credential prompt for wrong provider - prompts for GitHub credential while it needs Gmail credential for running Gmail block
source_issues.evidence: Reported by Toran in prod (session 73f57993-c371-4619-9b92-bbf3c4027f24). AutoPilot emitted setup_requirements requesting GitHub credentials (provider: github, scopes: repo) instead of Google credentials needed for Gmail. Root cause hypothesized: memory prompt from prior session containing GitHub credential requests confused the LLM. Workaround requires deleting all Google integrations and reconnecting. Related to existing open issues on duplicate Google credentials and OAuth scope mismatch.

signals.topic: Accessing platform via www subdomain causes authentication failure and empty agent library, preventing users from accessing their saved agents

This is a common user behavior (many users naturally type www) that silently breaks the platform's core functionality with no user-facing error message.
aliases: agent library empty on www URL
signals.review_reason: Common UX failure triggered by a natural user behavior (typing www prefix). Users lose access to their saved agents—a core platform feature. The empty library is particularly confusing because agents exist but are invisible. Downgraded to P1 because count=1 and single-repository, but the review_reason confirms genuine user impact.

source_issues.title: Adding "www." to the start of the url breaks the platform
source_issues.evidence: User reports: going to https://www.platform.agpt.co/ causes logout even when logged in at non-www URL. After re-login, the agent library shows no agents even though agents exist. SEO impact also flagged (Ahrefs reports duplicate pages without canonical). Steps to reproduce: (1) Go to www URL, (2) observe logout, (3) log back in, (4) go to library, (5) observe empty library.

signals.topic: API endpoint rejects requests with 'undefined' as version query parameter, causing validation errors for library agent lookups
signals.summary: The GET /api/library/agents/by-graph/{graph_id} endpoint receives 'undefined' as the version query parameter from the frontend, triggering a Pydantic validation error. This is a platform-frontend integration bug where the version parameter is not properly serialized before being sent to the API, blocking library agent retrieval.
aliases: undefined version query param API error
signals.review_reason: Real user-facing API validation error captured in Sentry, blocking library agent retrieval. Downgraded to P1 because count=1 and single-repository, but the Sentry evidence confirms actual users hitting this error in production.

source_issues.title: Validation failed for GET /api/library/agents/by-graph/{graph_id}
source_issues.evidence: Sentry issue AUTOGPT-SERVER-495 captures the validation error: version parameter receives 'undefined' string instead of an integer. Error message: 'Input should be a valid integer, unable to parse string as an integer, input: undefined'. This is a frontend-platform integration bug where the version query param is not properly handled.

signals.review_reason: This is a real user pain point: Neovim users on 0.12.0+ experience an unhandled LSP handler error that causes their primary workflow (code autocompletion) to completely stop working. The crash is triggered by a ChatFeature registration request that should not be sent to non-VSCode clients. Although count=1, the impact is severe (workflow-blocking autocompletion failure) and is confirmed by a cross-repo issue in vim-tabby (issue #40), indicating it affects multiple users in the community. The proposed fix is also identified in the issue.

signals.topic: Memory compression with stream=True causes agent crash (AttributeError/BadRequestError)
signals.summary: When ReActAgent uses compression_config and the compression model reuses the main model with stream=True enabled, memory compression triggers a crash. Two distinct error modes are observed: (1) AttributeError 'NoneType' object has no attribute 'metadata' in _compress_memory_if_needed, and (2) BadRequestError 'This response_format type is unavailable now' immediately after compression fires on subsequent tool calls. Both block the agent's main execution loop and make the compression feature unusable in streaming scenarios.
aliases: context compression breaks agent after trigger
signals.review_reason: This is a critical workflow blocker: two separate users independently hit crashes when using the memory compression feature with streaming-enabled models. The compression step is a core agent capability that, once triggered, either crashes the process immediately (#1546) or renders the agent unable to call tools on subsequent turns (#1526). Both are high-impact main-flow failures with complete reproduction steps and full stack traces. Count=2, both from agentscope-ai/agentscope, both recent.

source_issues.title: [Bug]:compression_model 启用 stream=True 时 _compress_memory_if_needed 报 AttributeError: 'NoneType' object has no attribute 'metadata'
source_issues.evidence: Agent crashes with AttributeError when compression_model uses stream=True and the async generator yields no chunk — last_chunk stays None and accessing .metadata crashes the agent process.

source_issues.title: [Bug]:当上下文token数达到压缩阈值并触发上下文压缩时，之后再进行对话，大型模型调用工具将导致报错
source_issues.evidence: After memory compression triggers (7385 > threshold 5000), subsequent tool calls fail with BadRequestError: 'This response_format type is unavailable now', blocking the agent from functioning normally.

signals.topic: ToolGroup dynamic activation causes tools to remain unavailable across threads
signals.summary: ToolGroup.active is not declared volatile and activeGroups uses a non-thread-safe ArrayList, causing race conditions where tool activation state is not visible across threads. Tools remain unavailable (Unauthorized) even after being activated, iterated 3 rounds, and waited 20 seconds, because the isActiveGroup check on a different thread reads the stale default value false.
aliases: tool activation not visible across threads
signals.review_reason: This is a concrete thread-safety bug with a precise root cause (missing volatile, non-thread-safe ArrayList) that causes tools to silently remain unavailable after activation. The activation appears to succeed (logs confirm it) but the tool remains inaccessible — a deceptive UX that blocks users from using dynamically activated tool groups. While count=1, the root cause is well-identified and the impact is a complete tool unavailability, warranting P1.

source_issues.title: [Bug]:工具组动态激活后not available
source_issues.evidence: Root cause: ToolGroup.active is a plain boolean without volatile modifier, and activeGroups is a plain ArrayList. The boundedElastic thread pool causes cross-thread writes where one thread writes active=true but another thread reads the stale initial value false, resulting in Unauthorized errors and tools not being usable even after explicit activation.

signals.topic: DashScopeChatModel incorrectly routes qwen3.6 models to text-only API instead of multimodal API
signals.summary: DashScopeChatModel determines whether to use multimodal or text API by checking for '-vl' in the model name. The qwen3.6 series (e.g., qwen3.6-plus) lacks this suffix but supports multimodal inputs. When a user sends an image message with such a model, the framework incorrectly routes to the text generation API which cannot process images, resulting in a 'url error' failure.
aliases: model name detection misses qwen3.6 multimodal
signals.review_reason: This causes complete failure of multimodal image handling for qwen3.6 model users — images are silently routed to the wrong API endpoint that cannot process them. Users see 'url error' with no clear indication that the root cause is a model-name heuristic. Though count=1, the issue is well-documented with clear evidence of the routing logic failure, and the impact is a core multimodal feature being completely broken for a widely-used model family.

source_issues.title: DashScopeChatModel对qwen3.6多模态路由错误
source_issues.evidence: Model qwen3.6-plus contains no '-vl' substring so it is routed to the text-only aigc.generation API. When the user sends an image message, the text API rejects it with 'url error'. The qwen3-vl-plus model works because it contains '-vl', but qwen3.6-series models silently fail.

signals.topic: Team coordination mode (HITL) broken when stream_events=True — pause never fires, sessions not persisted, context lost on resume, parallel delegation deadlocks
signals.summary: When stream_events=True is used with Team in coordinate mode, the HITL (Human-In-The-Loop) workflow is fundamentally broken across 4 distinct failure modes: (1) TeamRunPausedEvent never fires so pause UI never shows; (2) member agent sessions are not persisted to DB, making acontinue_run fail after process restart; (3) after resuming a member HITL pause, the Leader loses all conversation context and re-plans from scratch, causing duplicate work and context overflow; (4) parallel delegation to multiple HITL members causes asyncio.gather deadlock.
aliases: HITL session persistence failure after restart
Member HITL context loss on acontinue_run
signals.review_reason: Four distinct bugs in Team coordinate mode's HITL workflow, all confirmed with reproduction steps and affecting the core human-in-the-loop approval flow. Stream_events=True is needed for real-time UI updates, but it makes HITL completely non-functional. Member sessions not persisting means HITL workflows fail after any process restart. Context loss causes duplicate agent execution. Parallel delegation deadlock makes multi-member HITL impossible. Together these represent a complete breakdown of a major workflow pattern.

source_issues.title: [Bug] stream_events=True prevents TeamRunPausedEvent from being emitted (HITL broken)
source_issues.evidence: With stream_events=True, TeamRunPausedEvent is never emitted even though a member agent has requires_confirmation=True tool. The async generator completes or hangs indefinitely. This breaks HITL for any real-time UI that needs streaming + human approval simultaneously.

source_issues.title: [Bug] Team.acontinue_run fails to find member agent run after process restart — member session not persisted in coordinate mode
source_issues.evidence: Member agent's run is never saved to its own session in the DB because asave_session skips persistence when agent.team_id is set. After process restart, acontinue_run fails with 'No runs found for run ID'. The confirmed action (e.g., sending a Telegram message) never executes.

source_issues.title: [Bug] acontinue_run loses conversation context after member-level HITL resume — Leader re-plans from scratch
source_issues.evidence: After resolving a member HITL pause and calling acontinue_run, the Leader loses all prior context. Creates a new plan and re-delegates to ALL agents, ignoring already-completed work. Observed causing 2.9M token context overflow on second iteration.

source_issues.title: [Bug] Parallel member delegation with multiple HITL members causes deadlock — TeamRunPausedEvent never emitted
source_issues.evidence: When Leader delegates to 2+ members with HITL tools in parallel, asyncio.gather blocks waiting for all to complete. HITL-paused members can never complete without user resolution, so TeamRunPausedEvent is never emitted and the system hangs indefinitely.

signals.topic: Silent data loss: Knowledge content not persisted, partial workflow content lost on cancel, MCP structuredContent dropped
signals.summary: Three separate data loss bugs: (1) Knowledge._update_content silently skips upsert when content row is missing instead of inserting; (2) single-step workflow cancellation loses partial generated content from chat history while multi-step works fine; (3) MCPTools discards structuredContent field from CallToolResult, breaking MCP Apps generative UI (AG-UI/CopilotKit clients receive no payload).
aliases: Knowledge update silently skips insert on missing row
Single-step workflow partial content lost on cancel
MCP structuredContent dropped from tool results
signals.review_reason: Three distinct data loss scenarios, each with confirmed reproduction. Knowledge silently skips writes with only a warning. Workflow cancellation loses user-generated content only in single-step mode. MCP structuredContent loss breaks the entire MCP Apps generative UI ecosystem. All three are silent failures with no error surfaced to the user.

source_issues.title: [Bug] knowledge `_update_content` silently bails when content row missing
source_issues.evidence: Knowledge._update_content and _aupdate_content return None instead of upserting when content row is missing. Only a warning log is emitted. Users see no error but data is never written to DB.

source_issues.title: [Bug] Partial content is not saved to history when cancelling a single-step workflow
source_issues.evidence: When cancelling a single-step workflow during generation, partial content is not persisted to chat history. The same cancellation in a multi-step workflow correctly saves the partial content. User loses generated content.

source_issues.title: [Bug] MCP: `CallToolResult.structuredContent` is silently dropped by the tool wrapper
source_issues.evidence: MCPTools drops structuredContent from CallToolResult when converting to ToolResult. This breaks MCP Apps generative UI flows — the Prefab UI tree (used by AG-UI/CopilotKit) lives in structuredContent and is silently lost. Downstream clients must re-invoke the tool to recover the data.

signals.topic: Team cancel_run does not cascade to currently-running member agents — resources wasted
signals.summary: When a team run is cancelled via cancel_run(team_run_id), only the team-level execution is interrupted. Member agents that are currently running continue to completion because they generate their own run_id via uuid4(), which does not match the team's cancelled_runs entry. This wastes tokens, compute, and time.
aliases: Team cancel doesn't cascade to members
signals.review_reason: Confirmed resource waste with a reproduction script showing a member agent completing a 12,498-character essay after the team was already cancelled. The root cause is clear: member run_ids don't match the team's cancelled_runs entry. While count=1 prevents P0, the waste is direct and predictable for any team with running members at cancellation time.

source_issues.title: [Bug] Team cancel does not cascade to currently-running member agents
source_issues.evidence: Reproduction shows member generated a full 12,498-character essay after team was already cancelled. Member's run_id is different from team's run_id, so raise_if_cancelled() never detects cancellation. Clear resource waste with reproduction script.

signals.topic: ChromaDb async_insert/async_upsert blocks the asyncio event loop — starves concurrent coroutines
signals.summary: ChromaDb's async_insert and async_upsert methods are async in name only. After the embedding step, they call synchronous ChromaDB Rust batch operations directly on the asyncio event loop, blocking it for the duration of the batch. This starves all other coroutines (HTTP long-polls, queue drains, timers) and causes health-check timeouts in real async services.
aliases: ChromaDb async operations block event loop
ChromaDb async_upsert synchronous Rust call on loop thread
signals.review_reason: Confirmed with py-spy evidence showing the asyncio main thread blocked inside synchronous Rust code during an 'async' method call. This is a clear async/await semantics violation that directly causes service failures (health-check timeouts, stalled queues) in any async service using ChromaDb with Knowledge ingestion.

source_issues.title: [Bug] ChromaDb async upsert/insert blocks the asyncio event loop (sync Rust write on the loop thread)
source_issues.evidence: py-spy confirms the asyncio main thread is stuck inside synchronous chromadb.api.rust._upsert during async_upsert. Downstream effects: HTTP long-polls freeze, time-to-first-token measurements inflated, event queues backing up. Same file already uses asyncio.to_thread for other async methods.

signals.topic: Knowledge async session name setting blocks the main thread in async context
signals.summary: When calling aset_session_name with autogenerate=True in an async context, the method calls the synchronous team.model.response() instead of team.model.aresponse(), blocking the main thread. This freezes the entire FastAPI server while the model generates a session name, blocking all concurrent requests.
aliases: Synchronous model call in async session name generation
signals.review_reason: Blocks the entire FastAPI server during name generation, affecting all concurrent users. The root cause is clear: wrong sync vs async API choice in async code path. Reproducible in any async server using autogenerated session names.

source_issues.title: [Bug] Setting session name blocks main thread
source_issues.evidence: In a FastAPI async endpoint, when autogenerate=True is set on aset_session_name, the server hangs for all concurrent requests until name generation completes. The blocking happens because aset_session_name_util calls generate_session_name which uses team.model.response() instead of team.model.aresponse().

signals.topic: OpenRouter BYOK free quota cap error blocks paid subscribers from using core AI models
signals.summary: Paid OpenCode Go subscribers see 'Free BYOK request cap exceeded for this month' error across multiple models (Kimi K2.6, GLM 5.1), preventing any AI interaction. Users with active paid subscriptions and credits loaded are blocked from the primary workflow. Switching to a different model may work as a workaround, but the core path is broken.
signals.review_reason: Paid subscribers cannot use core AI models due to BYOK quota error despite having active subscriptions and credits. This is a primary workflow blocker affecting at least 3 distinct users across multiple models (Kimi K2.6, GLM). The workaround (model switch) confirms the root cause is the opencode-go/OpenRouter BYOK integration, not user accounts.

source_issues.title: All models: Free BYOK request cap exceeded for this month. Purchase credits at https://openrouter.ai/settings/credits
source_issues.evidence: User is an active OpenCode Go subscriber, all models show the free BYOK cap error, screenshot attached showing the error message.

source_issues.title: Free BYOK request cap exceeded for this month
source_issues.evidence: User is an active OpenCode Go subscriber with credits loaded, error appears on Kimi K2.6, switching to GLM 5.1 works.

source_issues.title: Free BYOK request cap exceeded for this month. Purchase credits at https://openrouter.ai/settings/credits
source_issues.evidence: Third user report of same error on Kimi K2.6 via OpenCode Go. 16 comments indicate it affected multiple users in discussion.

signals.topic: MCP streamable-HTTP session invalidation permanently breaks all tool calls without auto-reconnect
signals.summary: When a remote MCP server invalidates a streamable-HTTP session (server restart, idle timeout, periodic rotation), opencode continues sending the stale mcp-session-id. Every subsequent tool call against that MCP server permanently fails with 'Session not found' for the rest of the session. The only recovery is a full process restart (logout + auth + restart). No retry, no reconnect, no onclose handler.
aliases: MCP session not found no reconnect
MCP transport broken after server restart
signals.review_reason: Two confirmed paths for session invalidation: (1) MCP server restart/rotation invalidates streamable-HTTP session with no auto-reconnect, permanently breaking all tool calls, (2) Desktop app restores stale session IDs across different servers causing UI crash. Both represent permanent workflow failure requiring manual restart with no graceful degradation.

source_issues.title: MCP streamable-HTTP transport: 'Session not found' from server permanently breaks tool calls (no auto-reconnect)
source_issues.evidence: Remote MCP server restart causes permanent 'Session not found' error. All subsequent tool calls on that server fail. No retry/reconnect mechanism. User must restart opencode to recover. Confirmed in two MCP server scenarios.

source_issues.title: Desktop: switching servers can restore stale session IDs and crash with 'Session not found'
source_issues.evidence: Desktop app stores server/workspace state cross-server, restores stale session ID when switching servers causing NotFoundError crash. Confirmed in Desktop app on Windows with multi-server setup.

signals.topic: Thinking mode enters infinite character repetition loop, corrupting session and producing malformed tool calls
signals.summary: Qwen 3.6 Pro with thinking mode enabled produces infinite repeated characters (e.g., '!!!!!!!!!' or '...') in thinking blocks, making the model completely unusable. The corruption propagates to subsequent tool calls as malformed JSON, requiring user to interrupt and switch to a different model to continue working.
signals.review_reason: Thinking mode is a core feature that becomes permanently unusable once repetition starts, forcing users to abandon the model entirely. The corruption propagates to tool call generation (malformed JSON), which breaks the entire agent workflow. Severity is extreme even though count=1.

source_issues.title: Thinking mode gets stuck in infinite repetition loop (!!!!!!!!!!)
source_issues.evidence: Qwen 3.6 Pro thinking mode produces infinite repeated characters corrupting session. User had to switch to DeepSeek V4 Pro to write the bug report. JSON parse errors in subsequent tool calls confirmed.

signals.topic: Jinja template rendering crashes after context compaction with Qwen3 + LM Studio, blocking next turn
signals.summary: After context compaction (manual /compact or auto-compaction), the next user turn triggers a Jinja template error from LM Studio: 'No user query found in messages.' LM Studio renders 0 tokens (input and output), indicating the crash occurs during prompt rendering before inference. The compaction summary itself completes successfully, but the entire next turn is blocked. Affects at least 5 out of 94 sessions (5.3% crash rate).
aliases: LM Studio Qwen3 no user query error
signals.review_reason: Compaction is a core memory management feature. Its use directly causes the next turn to crash, blocking the primary workflow. 5.3% crash rate per session is significant. The crash is deterministic (happens on every post-compaction turn), not an edge case. However, LM Studio's jinja template may also be a factor, so marking P1.

source_issues.title: Jinja template error after compaction with Qwen3 + LM Studio: 'No user query found in messages' despite user turns present
source_issues.evidence: 5 confirmed crash sessions out of 94 in local SQLite DB, all after compaction. LM Studio jinja template fails with 0 tokens. Payloads verified to contain user messages, suggesting opencode message formatting incompatibility with LM Studio's Qwen3 template.

signals.topic: Windows Terminal over SSH + tmux: Korean and emoji text renders broken/hidden in TUI
signals.summary: When using opencode TUI via Windows Terminal -> SSH -> Linux -> tmux, Korean text, emoji, and UTF-8 characters are visibly broken or hidden in the UI. The issue persists even after filtering a separate OSC startup leak. The same configuration works correctly with Termius on the same server, indicating an opencode or OpenTUI rendering path specific to Windows Terminal over SSH.
signals.review_reason: Two reports with identical reproduction path and symptoms, plus references to 6 related upstream issues. Korean/emoji rendering breakage blocks international users from basic TUI interaction when using Windows Terminal over SSH. Confirmed that a separate OSC leak fix does not resolve this, ruling out a downstream workaround.

source_issues.title: Windows Terminal over SSH: UTF-8/CJK rendering still breaks after filtering OSC startup leak
source_issues.evidence: Two separate reports (#25133, #25132) with identical repro: Windows Terminal -> SSH -> Linux -> tmux -> opencode. Korean/emoji broken. Same server works with Termius. OSC leak fix does not resolve it. Links to multiple related upstream OpenTUI issues.

source_issues.title: Windows Terminal over SSH still breaks Korean/emoji after OSC leak is filtered
source_issues.evidence: Second report of same Windows Terminal over SSH Korean/emoji rendering issue with independent repro. Related upstream issues referenced: #14768, #14661, #10491, opentui#255, #609, #514.

signals.topic: ToolResultBlock.ToParam() drops zero-value fields via omitzero, causing 400 errors in multi-turn agentic loops
signals.summary: CodeExecutionToolResultBlock, WebSearchToolResultBlock, and ToolSearchToolResultBlock ToParam() methods all silently drop stdout/stderr/return_code/error_code fields when they contain zero values, causing the API to return 400 on the next agentic-loop iteration.
signals.review_reason: Three confirmed issues (#322, #317, #242) with the same root cause — omitzero struct tags on ToolResultBlock.ToParam() methods silently dropping required fields when they contain zero values. This directly breaks the main agentic loop workflow: multi-turn conversations fail with 400 API errors on the second turn. The issue is reliably reproducible in production and affects all three server tool result block types, indicating a systematic SDK design flaw.

source_issues.title: CodeExecutionToolResultBlock.ToParam() drops stdout/stderr/return_code via omitzero (same class as #242, #317)
source_issues.evidence: API returns 400 error: 'type: Input should be 'code_execution_tool_result_error'' — because omitzero drops stdout/stderr/return_code, making the content object invalid. Reliably reproducible in production with multi-turn agentic loops using claude-opus-4-7 with extended thinking.

source_issues.title: ToolSearchToolResultBlock.ToParam() drops error_code via omitzero
source_issues.evidence: Same omitzero pattern as #322, drops error_code field causing 400 on re-serialization.

source_issues.title: WebSearchToolResultBlock.ToParam() drops error_code via omitzero
source_issues.evidence: Same omitzero pattern, drops error_code causing 400 in agentic re-serialization.

signals.topic: JSONOutputFormatParam.Type field elided from request body, causing structured-output requests to hang with 10-minute timeout
signals.summary: The Type field in JSONOutputFormatParam is silently omitted from the marshaled JSON body, causing the Anthropic API to silently hang structured-output requests for the full timeout duration (10 minutes) instead of returning a 400 error.
signals.review_reason: Single issue but with severe user impact: structured-output requests silently hang for 10 minutes with no error signal, wasting time and compute. The root cause (omitzero on Type field despite default struct tag) is clearly documented and reproducible. The user provides a byte-replacement workaround, confirming real-world impact. Downgraded to P1 because count=1 and only affects structured-output users.

source_issues.title: JSONOutputFormatParam.Type elided from request body, causes API to hang structured-output requests
source_issues.evidence: SDK v1.33.0 marshals 'format':{'schema':{...}} without the required 'type' field. The API silently hangs instead of returning 400. The same params complete in seconds via the Python SDK. SDK's CalculateNonStreamingTimeout fires at 10 minutes returning context deadline exceeded. User needs a custom RoundTripper workaround.

signals.topic: Bedrock streaming decoder silently swallows errors, breaking error handling in streaming requests
signals.summary: Bedrock's eventstreamDecoder captures errors but the wrapper's Err() method never returns them, so streaming errors are silently swallowed and users cannot handle them.
signals.review_reason: Single issue on Bedrock-specific code path. Errors are silently swallowed rather than returned, breaking error handling for streaming requests on Bedrock. While real impact exists (users cannot handle streaming errors per the documented pattern), count=1 and Bedrock is a specific provider path, so P2 is appropriate.

source_issues.title: Bedrock streaming decoder error not returned
source_issues.evidence: The README-provided pattern for capturing streaming errors does not work on Bedrock because the error captured in eventstreamDecoder.err is never returned by ssestream.Err(). Errors are silently lost instead of being propagated to the user.

signals.topic: Documentation examples use non-existent Go types, preventing users from copy-paste usage
signals.summary: The official documentation at platform.claude.com includes Go code examples with types that do not exist in the SDK (v1.35.1), making the examples unusable.
signals.review_reason: Documentation issue that blocks users from getting started with Beta features. Users cannot copy-paste the documented code because referenced types don't exist in the SDK. While real experience degradation, single count and documentation-only scope warrant P2.

source_issues.title: Examples in documentation use types that don't exist.
source_issues.evidence: User cannot compile the documented Go example for Beta Sessions API because types BetaManagedAgentsUserDefineOutcomeEventParams, BetaManagedAgentsTextRubricParams, etc. do not exist in SDK v1.35.1. The code is copy-paste broken.

signals.topic: Bedrock SSE streaming错误时SDK抛出ValueError而非APIStatusError，导致流式请求崩溃
signals.summary: Bedrock SSE流在遇到错误事件（如HTTP 400）时，SDK直接抛出未捕获的ValueError（issue #1477）或AttributeError on NoneType（issue #1472），导致整个流式请求中断，而非将其转换为用户可感知并处理的APIStatusError。
aliases: bedrock streaming crash on error event
signals.review_reason: 两个issue均来自同一用户(sevakva)，均为Bedrock SSE streaming场景下的错误处理缺失导致流式请求崩溃。#1477中SDK抛出原始ValueError而非用户可处理的APIStatusError；#1472中当Bedrock返回type:error的SSE帧时，message对象为None导致AttributeError。两者均为可复现的主流程阻断（streaming是核心功能），用户无法捕获并优雅处理错误，属于明确的用户痛点。

source_issues.title: Bedrock streaming SSE events errors are not handled gracefully
source_issues.evidence: Bedrock SSE流返回400错误时SDK直接raise ValueError，堆栈显示发生在bedrock/_stream_decoder.py第58行，阻断整个流式请求，用户期望得到可捕获的APIStatusError

source_issues.title: Streaming error SSE event causes AttributeError: 'NoneType' object has no attribute errors
source_issues.evidence: Bedrock跨区域推理时streaming在首个事件即崩溃：decoded object为BetaRawMessageStartEvent但message=None，触发AttributeError: 'NoneType' object has no attribute 'model'或'.usage'，流式请求完全失败

signals.topic: AsyncAnthropicVertex在US/EU区域发送错误endpoint导致404，async方法完全不可用
signals.summary: 使用AsyncAnthropicVertex且region设置为US或EU时，SDK向错误的endpoint发送POST请求（发送至googleapis.com而非rep.googleapis.com），导致所有async调用均返回404错误，而同步版本(SyncAnthropicVertex)正常工作。
aliases: vertex ai async us eu region
signals.review_reason: P0理由：async方法在US/EU region（全球最常用区域）完全不可用，返回404。sync方法正常说明endpoint逻辑有bug（async发送至googleapis.com而sync发送至rep.googleapis.com）。async是现代Python异步应用的核心使用方式，此bug直接阻断该场景下所有用户的核心使用路径。count=1但有明确的强用户影响证据（主流程阻断+全区域不可用）。

source_issues.title: Async methods NOT working with US/EU regions on Vertex AI - Gets 404 on endpoints

signals.topic: Streaming请求在code_execution+skills场景下中途断流，httpx.RemoteProtocolError导致连接关闭并产生重复计费
signals.summary: 当请求包含code_execution和skills时，streaming在content_block_delta事件传输过程中连接被服务器端关闭（httpx.RemoteProtocolError: peer closed connection），每次重试均需全额支付已计费的input tokens和部分output tokens，造成直接财务损失。
signals.review_reason: P0理由：主流程阻断（streaming为用户核心使用路径）+ 明确财务损失（每次retry全额计收input tokens + 已有partial output被重复计费）。用户在真实生产场景（code_execution+skills组合）下遭遇，是高频触发路径。issue直接引用financial impact，URL证据充分。count=1但符合P0主流程阻断+明确财务损失双条件。

source_issues.title: Streaming /v1/messages drops mid-stream with RemoteProtocolError on long code_execution + skills runs
source_issues.evidence: streaming在传输content_block_delta事件期间被服务器关闭连接，httpx.RemoteProtocolError: peer closed connection without sending complete message body。每次retry均全额计收input tokens（已部分streaming的output tokens也被重复计费），用户明确指出financial impact。issue关联TypeScript SDK #842说明为跨SDK共性问题。

signals.topic: ServerToolResult在client tools并发中断流时无法到达，导致前端卡死和孤立server_tool_use块
signals.summary: 当Messages API返回stop_reason=tool_use时，如果server-side工具（code_execution、web_search）正在并发运行，ServerToolResult内容块永远不会被传递，流在结果到达前就结束了。导致前端出现卡死spinner，且存在孤立的server_tool_use块无对应结果。
signals.review_reason: P0理由：主流程阻断（server-side tools是API核心功能）+ 关键功能不可用（ServerToolResult不传递=无法处理工具结果）。用户体验严重受损（前端卡死），开发者收到孤立块无法处理，造成应用逻辑错误。这是server-side并发场景下的结构性bug，非边缘情况。

source_issues.title: ServerToolResult not delivered when client tools interrupt the stream (code_execution + client tool concurrency)
source_issues.evidence: stop_reason=tool_use时server-side工具并发运行，ServerToolResult永远不传递。Stream ends before results arrive. 后果：frontend stuck spinners（体验破坏）+ orphaned server_tool_use blocks with no matching result（逻辑错误）。应用层使用server-side工具时产生孤立块，导致程序无法正确处理。

signals.topic: 连续两条相同系统提示的请求缓存命中率约60%，导致40%的请求被重复收取cache_creation_input_tokens费用
signals.summary: 两个完全相同（identical）的back-to-back消息创建请求，第二次请求的缓存命中率仅约60%，即约40%的时间第二次请求被当作新请求全额计费（包含cache_creation_input_tokens）。用户估算每个冗余写入以全cache_creation价格计费，造成持续性财务损失。
signals.review_reason: P1（非P0）理由：明确财务损失（持续性按全价计费）但count=1且被描述为服务器端bug。用户已标注'server-side bug'，SDK层面修复空间可能有限，但SDK可考虑在缓存miss场景下提供更多可见性或workaround。保留为P1因有明确计费异常证据。

source_issues.title: Cache misses on second back-to-back client.messages.create() (~40% rate)
source_issues.evidence: 两个identical back-to-back请求产生约40% cache miss rate。用户明确指出financial damage：每个冗余写入按cache_creation_input_tokens全价计费。sleep 2秒可消除miss，说明存在竞态条件或服务端缓存过期问题。用户在SDK 0.96.0和0.97.0均可复现。

signals.topic: JSON streaming parser crashes with unhandled SyntaxError on invalid escape sequences from model output
signals.summary: 当模型输出包含非标准转义序列（如正则字面量 \d、\s、\p，或 PHP 命名空间 \H、\M）的 JSON 时，MessageStream 中的 JSON.parse 调用抛出未捕获的 SyntaxError，导致整个 Node.js 进程崩溃。这在 streaming 管道中（MessageStream.mjs 第 501 行 partialParse 调用）无法恢复。
aliases: invalid escape sequences model output crash
signals.review_reason: 两个独立 issue 均报告了由同一根因（partial-json-parser 的 generate() 函数未对字符串 token 做反斜杠转义修复）引发的应用崩溃。#996 报告了主流水线 JSON.parse 崩溃；#986 报告了 _vendor/partial-json-parser 内部 partialParse 崩溃，均有完整复现步骤和堆栈。这是主流程阻断（streaming 不可用）+ 无用户侧 workaround（崩溃发生在 SDK 内部），完全符合 P0 标准。

source_issues.title: bug(streaming): JSON.parse crashes on invalid escape sequences in model output
source_issues.evidence: unhandled SyntaxError crashes the entire application when Claude outputs regex-like content (\d, \s, \p) inside JSON strings; no recovery possible during streaming; example: Claude asked to produce JSON with regex pattern field

source_issues.title: partialParse in _vendor/partial-json-parser crashes on invalid JSON escape sequences from model output

signals.topic: Published SDK v0.91.1 dist files contain malformed @ts-ignore comments causing TypeScript compilation errors in user projects
signals.summary: v0.91.1 引入 stainless-app 格式化 dist/* 文件后，/* @ts-ignore ... */ 块注释被改为 /* @ts-ignore ... */ （少了开头的斜杠），导致 TypeScript 将 @ts-ignore 当作普通注释而非编译器指令，tsc 报错 TS2307: Cannot find module 'undici-types'。用户 node_modules/@anthropic-ai/sdk 报错，必须手动修复或降级版本。
signals.review_reason: v0.91.1 发布的 dist 文件存在格式问题，直接导致用户项目的 TypeScript 编译失败（TS2307），属于发布质量缺陷。count=1 且无其他相似 issue 报同类问题，但影响明确：所有使用 v0.91.1 且依赖类型检查的项目均受影响，属于关键功能（类型可用性）不可用，定级 P1 而非 P0。

source_issues.title: Bug: Broken dist `@ts-ignore` in v0.91.1

signals.topic: betaZodTool return type BetaRunnableTool is not assignable to ToolUnion, causing TS2322 on messages.stream/create
